notes: Do not spend provider calls on backend metadata, allocation collisions, retry plumbing or representation-only repair.
Do not use the LLM as the Show database; retrieve compact verified context from Knowledge/State/cache.
Song-specific cue counts and labels belong to the calling task, not the generic compiler.
Preset and Effect objects are implementation resources, not the artistic ontology.
Ordinary implementation collisions self-heal; they are not human-review events.
A ShowPlan that already passed canonical compilation is frozen for backend retry unless a referenced runtime resource actually disappears.
Unsupported artistic dimensions stay explicit; never silently substitute another meaning.
Live mode is local/event-driven first; call an LLM only for meaningful interpretation.

The ordinary OpenClaw lean path may reuse Test Show evidence only through the same exact current-Show identity, exact Group membership and fresh object readback gates as the bounded runner; runner-only trust shortcuts are forbidden.

rules: Group name does not imply capability.
Preset type does not imply Group applicability.
Effect existence/ID does not imply artistic verification.
Only Group-bound executable Preset/Effect resources may be offered to the designer.
Unknown or unsupported dimensions remain explicit and are never semantically substituted.
